summary: Transform each record into a useful new value.
documentation: map calls a callback for assigned elements and returns a new array containing the callback results in corresponding positions.
inputs: An array and a transformation callback.
returns: A new array of transformed values.
caution: A callback with braces needs an explicit return. Sparse array holes stay holes.
scenarios: Build a list of product labels from inventory records.
Convert API records to the format a chart expects.
Create invoice line totals from quantities and unit prices.
title: Calculate each line total
problem: Given line items with quantity and unitPriceCents, return an array of quantity × unitPriceCents for each item. Prices use integer cents.
goal: Use Array.map() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Map each line to its quantity multiplied by its unit price.
